abstract: Choriocarcinoma is a malignant growth of trophoblastic cells characterized by the secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin. Primary choriocarcinoma arising in the placenta during a seemingly normal gestation is rare. Very few choriocarcinomas occurring simultaneously in mother and child have been reported so far. We describe an additional case of placental choriocarcinoma metastasizing to the newborn and showing many different cutaneous tumors. The primary tumor was found in the placenta. In the newborn, diagnosis was performed by skin biopsy only a few days after birth (by optic and electron microscopy). Immunohistochemical localization of human chorionic gonadotropin was performed by the immunoperoxidase technic with the use of monoclonal antibodies. This report describes an additional case and summarizes previously reported cases of placental choriocarcinoma metastasizing to the infant, as well as cases of skin metastases from malignant gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を分泌する栄養膜細胞の悪性腫瘍である。正常経過の妊娠中に胎盤に原発する絨毛癌は稀である。母子で同時に発生した絨毛癌の報告は、これまでごくわずかである。今回、胎盤原発の絨毛癌が新生児に転移し、多様な皮膚腫瘍を呈した症例を報告する。原発腫瘍は胎盤で発見された。新生児では、出生後数日の皮膚生検により、光学顕微鏡および電子顕微鏡で診断された。hCGの免疫組織化学的局在をモノクローナル抗体を用いたイムノペルオキシダーゼ法で検討した。本報告では、胎盤原発絨毛癌が乳児に転移した既報例と、悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患からの皮膚転移例を文献的にまとめた。
